brief:
The article criticizes the United Nations Security Council's inability to halt violations and ease Palestinian suffering amid ongoing Israeli military operations, blockade, and displacement in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The piece argues the body has failed in its mandate to protect civilians and achieve peace as violations continue.

The commentary highlights the absence of effective Security Council action to address the humanitarian crisis unfolding in the territory, where Palestinians face compounding pressures from combat, economic siege, and forced displacement.

title: UN Security Council fails to stop Gaza suffering, article says
